add.title: Add a PC
add.how: On the PC, open Vitals, go to Settings, Remote access, and choose Pair a TV. It shows a six-digit code.
add.addressBody: Type the PC’s address. The PC shows it under Settings, Remote access.
add.codeBody: Type the six digits the PC shows, with the remote’s number keys or the keypad below.
add.tokenBody: Type or paste the 43-character token from the PC.

pairing.notPrivate: That address is on the internet, not your home network. Vitals only talks to PCs on the local network.
pairing.badAddress: That does not look like an address.
pairing.badToken: The token should be 43 letters and numbers.
pairing.badCode: That code did not work. Codes last five minutes, and five wrong tries use one up. Ask the PC for a new one.
pairing.unauthorised: The PC refused the token. Check it, or create a new one.
pairing.incompatible: That PC runs a version of Vitals this app does not understand.
pairing.olderPc: That PC’s Vitals is too old for pairing codes. Update it, or use a token instead.
pairing.notReady: The PC is starting up. Try again in a moment.

settings.title: Settings
settings.aboutBody: Vitals measures this TV and, if you pair one, a Windows PC on your home network. No ads, no account, no analytics: nothing is sent to the developer.
settings.storage: Pairings are kept on this TV, inside the Vitals app. Removing the app removes them.

device.unavailable: Not available outside a Samsung TV.
device.limits: A TV web app may read only what Samsung’s system information API offers: load, memory, storage, network and screen. Temperatures and per-app figures are not available to it.
